records.title: On Importance of Layer Pruning for Smaller BERT Models and Low Resource Languages
records.reason: The primary-text review confirms a compact BERT pruning study for low-resource Marathi tasks, but its relevance to LLM inference and measured serving efficiency is weak and task-specific.

records.title: FPGA Routing Optimization Based on Multi-Level MUX Architecture
records.reason: The work optimizes FPGA routing/interconnect MUX architecture, not neural-network inference or model compression.

records.title: TileMap: Mapping Multi-Head Attention on Spatial Accelerators with Tile-based Analysis
records.reason: IEEE Xplore DOI page could not be retrieved as full text; other search results exposed bibliographic metadata only. Abstract proposes tile-based operator-fusion mapping for multi-head attention on spatial accelerators, plausibly relevant to Transformer memory/compute efficiency, but method/evaluation/limits could not be verified.

records.title: A Dense Retrieval Model Training Method Combining Matryoshka Representation Learning and Knowledge Distillation
records.reason: Abstract focuses on training dense retrieval representations with Matryoshka learning and distillation for RAG retrieval; it does not improve LLM inference or model serving.

records.title: An asymmetric heuristic for trained ternary quantization based on the statistics of the weights: An application to medical signal classification
records.reason: Primary publisher search identifies asymmetric trained ternary quantization for medical-signal classification. Its scope is task-specific signal classification, not language/Transformer inference.
